newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: In the South, rice prices were steady, USDA said in its weekly rice report.

Long grain milled rice prices were selling mostly at $21.00-$21.50 per cwt.; Medium grain traded mostly at $19.00; Second heads were steady and Brewers remain in very tight supply with few quotes at $14.25-$15.00.
Rice by-products were uneven, bran was $3.00 higher to $5.00 lower, millfeed was steady to $5.00 lower, instances $10.00 lower.
California rice ship loadings: For the week ending March 22 at the Port of Sacramento there were no rice ship loadings.
Inspections of California rice for export: For the week ending March 22, there were no inspections. The yearly total since October 1, 1996 was 7,771,645 cwt compared to 5,548,093 cwt a year ago.
